_readme: Generated by scripts/build-registry-variants.ts: do not edit by hand.
vin: first 8 VIN characters, plus the model-year character (10th) where known, to the EU type-approval
variant codes that cars with that prefix carry. From Traficom open vehicle data (Finland), licensed
days: date, then make, to the variant codes of the electric cars registered in Iceland that day.
names: make, then registered commercial name (letters and digits only), to the variant codes cars were
registered under that name with. coveredTo: the last registration date both are complete to.
days and names are from the European Environment Agency dataset Monitoring of CO2 emissions from passenger
A variant code is the type-approval Variant, followed by / and the first 3 characters of the Version
when the Variant is 3 characters or shorter. Holds no plates, no full VINs and nothing about owners.
